title: Review development recommendations
scenario: Python 3.11+, supplied synthetic development evidence and the current grader identity. The export producer remains an unmerged PR #35 dependency. No credentials, model calls or installation.

steps.title: Bind evidence before source review
steps.instruction: Open improvement-review in the map. Pass experiment, report, completions, current_spec and source_diff_digest to promotion.py recommend on stdin. Keep the experiment and current spec unchanged.
steps.caption: Actual local catalog dialog, cropped through the usage instructions.
steps.expected: The gate recomputes the report and binds its exact review references. It launches no model or command.

steps.title: Read the limits before acting
steps.instruction: Inspect recommendation, rule_result reasons and critical_violations_by_arm. Baseline-only critical defects do not reject a successful fix; candidate critical failures reject even with aggregate gain. Exit 0 alone is not eligibility; follow the source for both refusal shapes.
steps.caption: Browser-rendered summary of the actual synthetic CLI result, not a terminal capture.
steps.expected: The fixture exposes four baseline critical violations and zero candidate violations. Arithmetic is eligible, but the recommendation remains inconclusive; promotion, merge and installation stay unauthorized.
